goal.outcome: Produce a checked research brief without unauthorized publication.
goal.done_when: The brief passes checks and reaches its approved delivery boundary.

known.stakes: Drafting is reversible; external publication is consequential.
system_evidence: prior source audits passed deterministic citation checks
known.interruption_policy: Interrupt only for declared boundary crossings or unanticipated consequential ambiguity.
known.learning_preference: Explain unfamiliar research functions while demonstrating them.

anticipated_decisions.description: Whether to release the final brief outside the workspace.

questions.question: May the system publish, or may it only prepare a draft?
questions.route_effect: Changes the publication route from mandatory human action to bounded system eligibility.
questions.default_if_unanswered: Prepare a private draft and require explicit approval.
questions.risk_of_default: Slower delivery without an unauthorized external action.

assumptions: The system may create and verify local drafts.
